context: Tests intake discipline: stdin-fed payloads with no evidence scratch files, validate with --dry-run --json before applying the identical payload, the run id taken from next_action, concrete dependency-ordered units with acceptance criteria, and no self-release.

checklist.name: Dry run first
checklist.description: commands.md validates the intake with --dry-run --json before the apply, and the apply repeats the same payload without --dry-run

checklist.name: Stdin payload, no scratch files
checklist.description: The intake document travels via --file - with a heredoc/stdin payload; no JSON evidence file is written into the repository

checklist.name: Run id from next_action
checklist.description: Commands use --run run-7f2c exactly as printed by next_action, not an embedded run field or an invented id

checklist.name: Units concrete and ordered
checklist.description: The payload has two units matching the plan, with the nonce unit blocked on the signature unit, and each unit carries verifiable acceptance_criteria (e.g. unsigned payloads rejected with integration-test proof)

checklist.name: Run configuration complete
checklist.description: The payload declares delivery_mode pr-hold, required_reviewers including slopguard, and risk_tier low

checklist.name: No self-release
checklist.description: The sequence stops after intake (plus at most a status re-read) and asks for explicit human release approval; it does not include slopmachine release
